claims.claim: DefaultResourceLoader.reload() now transfers the decision returned by resolveProjectTrust to the settings manager instead of unconditionally marking the project trusted, so a denied decision no longer behaves like approval.
Bootstrap phase separation is unchanged: loadProjectTrustExtensions() still forces project settings untrusted and loads only user/global plus temporary CLI extensions before the decision exists.

Project settings/resources are exposed only while the project is trusted: SettingsManager drops project settings when untrusted and the package manager gates auto-discovered .pi resources on isProjectTrusted().
Project SYSTEM.md / APPEND_SYSTEM.md discovery stays gated on isProjectTrusted(), so the wrong trust value also leaked project prompts.

deliverables.change: One-line repair in DefaultResourceLoader.reload(): this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted) instead of setProjectTrusted(true).
Standalone Node assertion script that loads the real resource-loader.ts and settings-manager.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs with boundary fakes and asserts the four trust phases.

validation.notes: Regression loads packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts plus packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts as real modules via createGraph() and fakes only the boundaries (FakePackageManager, loadExtensionsCached, loadSkills, loadPromptTemplates, loadThemeFromPath, config/paths/text helpers, chalk+proper-lockfile default binding, findGitPaths, timings/event-bus stubs). The fake package manager mirrors production gating: project settings entries come from SettingsManager.getProjectSettings() (real, emptied while untrusted) and auto-discovered .pi/{extensions,skills,prompts,themes} entries are gated on settingsManager.isProjectTrusted(), matching DefaultPackageManager.addAutoDiscoveredResources(). Fixtures are created under .prale-eval/.tmp and removed in a finally block. Asserted phases: (1) during the resolveProjectTrust bootstrap callback only cli.ts + user.ts extensions are loaded and settings are still untrusted; (2) after a denied (false) decision project.ts, settings-extension.ts, project-skill, settings-skill, deploy prompt, project-theme and .pi/SYSTEM.md + .pi/APPEND_SYSTEM.md stay unloaded while user/global and CLI resources remain available; (3) a fresh loader approving (true) loads the project extensions, skills, prompts and project system prompt; (4) re-transfer on the same loader: true then false flips project resources on and off again. Verified locally in both directions: with the repair the command exits 0; with the original fault restored (setProjectTrusted(true)) it exits 1 with 'AssertionError: denied reload: project extensions must stay unloaded: unexpected project.ts in [cli.ts, project.ts, settings-extension.ts, user.ts]'. Limitation: this checkout has no node_modules and installing dependencies was out of scope, so the repository's vitest suite (packages/coding-agent/test/resource-loader.test.ts) and tsgo/tsc type checking could not be executed; the production module was instead parsed and executed through Node 24 TypeScript stripping in the VM graph, which is the same code path the regression exercises.
